pages.text: This chapter records every crafting, cooking, and smithing recipe, plus the special rites that a recipe book cannot show.$(br2)Recipe ingredients can be inspected directly. Ritual pages state the location, offerings, duration, and failure conditions.

pages.title: Reading Order
pages.text: Royal Implements covers common curios and the beacon. Phase-Law Metals shows the full ingot chain. Eternal Silence covers its totems, bow, and smithing template. Final Works contains the Chance Dice, Eternal Conquest, and Group U cooking.

pages.title: Curse I: Trial Cup
pages.text: Fill a cauldron with water and cast in every offering and quantity listed in the common configuration.$(br2)When all offerings are present, the cauldron begins a short vigil. Once its particles and response finish, Curse I is rewritten.

pages.title: Curse VI: Final Exchange
pages.text: Bring both a Dragon Egg and a Nether Star into the bounds of the central End island. The End must acknowledge both offerings at once for the exchange to complete.$(br2)Offering only one causes the void to return it, leaving the rite unfinished.

pages.title: Beyond Crafting
pages.text: Embers of Duat come from structure loot and very rare hostile drops. Satiety Crystals are issued after a Curse IX death. Dynasty-affix materials drop from enemies bearing the matching affix.$(br2)The Fission Wraith Heart, Dragon-Breath Compound Bow, and Apep revival each have a dedicated ritual page.
